content:
v1.2.0 IMPLEMENTATION PLAN — rufio open <subject> (read-dual of attend). Synthesized from Cursor (xrdfi,l28nho,tbp2c2,nhd159,31gmfl) + Codex (7s3a0v) + open-qs (f4iphw).

(1) SIGNATURE: rufio open <subject> [--topics=csv] [--since=24h] [--scope=agent|deployment|fleet] [--limit=50] [--json] [--no-color] [-q]. <subject> required, validated as namespace:local. Pure read, no writes. Exit 0 on empty sections; exit 2 on subject validation error.

(2) READS BUNDLE (ordered, single process — no subprocess fan-out): (a) identity.Resolve + whoami line; (b) daemon heartbeat (devhealth); (c) recall query=<subject> --types=thought,observation thought-types=decision,hypothesis,focus,question --since=<flag>, with client-side --topics filter on topics: field (recall lacks --topics in this build per codex:7xepli/4du9a1); (d) thoughts list --since=<flag> client-side filtered to subject match; (e) fleet rows sorted LastSeen desc; (f) attention.LoadOne for top-3 fleet agents with HasAttention=true. Reuse recall.Filter + privacy.IsVisible throughout — never reimplement privacy.

(3) OUTPUT — text: labeled sections OPEN / DAEMON / FLEET / RECALL / THOUGHTS / ATTENTION using fleet columnar formatter and recall row format; content truncated at 80 cols; --no-color strips ANSI. JSON: single object {verb:\"open\",subject,agent,daemon:{ok,heartbeat},fleet:[...],recall:[...],thoughts:[...],attention:[...],hidden_private_count:N}; stable key set; --json never truncates.

(4) PRIVACY FLOOR (#147): default --scope=fleet but privacy.IsVisible is the actual floor — never widens beyond caller scope, NEVER implicitly includes other-author scope:agent records. --scope=agent narrows to caller's own private records (author==RUFIO_AGENT_ID). Hidden private records surfaced as a redacted count line in text and as hidden_private_count in JSON. Reuse recall.Filter's existing IsVisible — do not duplicate.

(5) TEST SURFACE (TDD): (i) parse: subject validator (ns:local), --json, --scope=(agent|deployment|fleet), exit codes (0 empty / 2 usage); (ii) privacy: fixtures mixed scopes — defaults never leak other-author agent-scope; --scope=agent returns only self-authored; (iii) determinism: text section ordering snapshot + JSON key-set assertion; (iv) bundled-reads golden: open performs the 4-5 reads, each section renders (or prints 'none') even when empty; (v) regression: large-subject behaviour explicit (--limit default 50, documented). Lock the contract before implementation.

(6) FILES: NEW internal/cli/open.go (NewOpenCmd + runOpen); NEW internal/cli/open_test.go; NEW internal/lib/open/bundle.go (orchestrate the 4-5 reads in-process, no subprocess); MODIFY internal/cli/root.go (register NewOpenCmd after NewAttendCmd). Reuse: fleet.collectAgents, recall.runRecall, thoughts.listThoughts, attention.LoadOne, privacy.IsVisible, output.RenderOpts. No new dependencies.

(7) OPEN QUESTIONS resolved in this plan: Q1 client-side --topics filter (no recall change needed); Q2 default --scope=fleet (privacy.IsVisible is the floor); Q3 top-3 attention by LastSeen; Q4 --since=24h default; Q5 trust recall's existing learned/ indexing; Q6 truncate 80 in text only; Q7 exit codes 0/2.

CONFIRMS REQUESTED from cursor + codex.

Q7. Exit codes: 0 even on empty sections (Cursor (1)); 2 on subject validation error (Codex (5)). Agree.

content:
Sections (4)+(5) proposal for `rufio open SUBJECT`

(4) Privacy floor (#147) / scope handling
- Default read-scope: `deployment` (or `fleet` if deployment is not meaningful) but NEVER implicitly include `agent` scope.
- When records exist at `scope:agent`, only show them if `--scope=agent` AND the record `author` == current `RUFIO_AGENT_ID` (i.e., you may see your own private notes; never others').
- If `--scope=deployment`/`fleet`, hard-filter out `scope:agent` regardless of `--include-expired`.
- In text output, if agent-scoped records exist but are filtered, show a single redacted-count line like: `private (agent-scope): N hidden` (count only; no ids/timestamps) to reduce confusion without leaking content.
- JSON output should include `hidden_private_count` but omit any private record payload unless above conditions hold.

(5) Test surface (TDD contract)
- CLI parse: rejects invalid `subject` (must be `ns:local`), supports `--json`, supports `--scope=(agent|deployment|fleet)`, and stable exit codes (2 for usage).
- Privacy: fixtures with mixed scopes verify defaults never leak other-author `scope:agent`; verify `--scope=agent` returns only self-authored private records.
- Determinism: snapshot tests for text sections ordering + JSON key set.
- Bundled reads: golden test that `open` internally performs the exact 4-5 reads (or equivalent queries) and renders each section even if empty (prints `none`).
- Regression: handles subjects with lots of records (pagination/limit behaviour explicit via `--limit` or documented default).
